Container.Name: immich-dlna-proxy
Container.Overview: Exposes Immich albums and named people (photos only) as a DLNA MediaServer so Smart TVs can browse and display them without an extra app. Uses host networking because SSDP relies on UDP multicast, which does not traverse Docker's bridge network.

Config.Name: Immich URL
Config.Description: Base URL of your Immich server (host:port), reachable from this container. With host networking, this is usually just your Unraid server's own IP and the Immich port.

Config.Name: Immich API Key
Config.Description: Immich API key with album.read / asset.read / person.read permissions. Create one under Immich > Account Settings > API Keys.

Config.Name: Friendly Name
Config.Description: Name shown on TVs when browsing available DLNA servers.

Config.Name: Listen Address
Config.Description: host:port the HTTP part (description.xml, SOAP control, media streaming) binds to. Since networking is host mode, make sure this port is free on your Unraid server.

Config.Name: Device UUID
Config.Description: Optional: set a fixed UUID if you run more than one instance, so each has a stable identity. Leave empty to use the built-in default.

Config.Name: SSDP Interface
Config.Description: Optional: restrict SSDP discovery to a single network interface name (e.g. eth0). Leave empty to use all interfaces.

Config.Name: Cache
Config.Description: Host folder for the disk cache of photo bytes, so repeated views don't re-download from Immich. Survives container recreation.

Config.Name: Cache Max Size (MB)
Config.Description: Soft size budget for the cache folder in MB. Oldest-viewed photos are evicted first once exceeded.

Config.Name: Disable Cache
Config.Description: Set to true to disable disk caching entirely and always stream live from Immich.

Config.Name: Max Resolution
Config.Description: Optional: downscale photos larger than this to fit, e.g. 1920x1080. Aspect ratio is preserved; smaller photos are untouched. Only JPEG/PNG are downscaled. Leave empty to always serve full resolution.
